intro: Dirge Quikcleave in Gadgetzan has finished working out his recipe. He still needs twenty Goblin Rocket Fuel and twenty Deeprock Salt from you, and he wants them fast so the meat you brought him does not spoil.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My recipe is complete! What I need from you now is some rocket fuel and deeprock salt. I'll handle the spices and the meat you brought me will cover the rest.
After you bring me what I asked for, the chicken will be ready to take back to Narain.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hurry it up, kid. We don't want this meat to go bad.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It's ready! I present to you my greatest creation: Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok Chops!
